content: Standard pattern for a football/soccer pitch layout component: a position:relative container sized to the pitch aspect ratio, with player tokens position:absolute using percentage-based top/left (not px) so it's responsive across screen sizes. Tailwind CSS utilities (relative, absolute, top-[x%], left-[x%]) are commonly used; percentage-based coords keep formation layouts (rows per position: GK/DEF/MID/FWD) proportional at any container width.
